root_cause_analysis.symptom: Inline Markdown after ***...*** is swallowed into unintended italic text; table cells render literal Markdown delimiters.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: parseMarkdownSpans.ts uses a regex-only token walk whose bold/italic alternatives accept end-of-string as a closing delimiter, so an overlapping * run can consume following tokens instead of preserving independent token boundaries. Separately, table text flows from parseMarkdownBlock as string[]/string[][] into MarkdownView table cell renderers and bypasses RenderSpans, so cell contents never enter the inline parser.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 0dd09cc3 for table-cell inline regression (restored string table rows to fix empty cells); no single confirmed commit for *** leakage because bisect is blocked and the fragile emphasis regex predates the current task.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: 0dd09cc3 intentionally prioritized preserving empty table cells and native web table behavior after 3311f7ec used MarkdownSpan cells with lossy filtering. The regex parser was extended incrementally for LaTeX/strikethrough/kbd without a full delimiter-stack/tokenizer pass.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The renderer now has two correctness gaps on common Claude output: cell text bypasses inline parsing, and one emphasis edge case corrupts all downstream inline tokens in a line.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Table inline support added in 3311f7ec, removed by 0dd09cc3. Current parser probe on 2026-05-07 reproduces both current failures.
